output.notes: Encoder-decoder Transformer; block_ops describe one encoder layer (bidirectional self-attention + ReLU FFN, post-LN); the decoder (causal self-attention, cross-attention, FFN) is listed under mechanisms_outside_ir, and the head is the decoder's tied output projection. Base listed first as primary; big (1024/4096/16 heads, 6 layers) is the headline 28.4 BLEU model. Big's head_dim is not in its table row ('Unlisted values are identical to those of the base model'); 64 follows d_model/h. Vocab is 'about 37000' shared BPE for EN-DE; EN-FR uses 32000 word-pieces. Context length, LayerNorm eps and QKV-projection bias are not stated. Dropout is training-only and omitted.
